sub.scene: A shopper pushes a trolley past shelves of fruit, vegetables and bread in a bright supermarket.
A waiter hands a menu to a couple seated at a candle-lit restaurant table.
A person stirs a pan on a stove in a home kitchen with chopped vegetables on a board.
Two friends hold cups of coffee and tea at a small café counter with a pastry display.
A family shares dishes around a dinner table, one person tasting soup with a spoon.
A customer points to a menu while a server gestures to show which dishes are safe, with a vegetable plate on the table.

words.ex: We need bread and milk from the shop.
words.tip: Bread /bred/ – ổ bánh mì.

words.ex: I put milk in my tea every morning.
words.tip: Milk – sữa, từ cực quen.

words.ex: She bought a dozen eggs at the market.
words.tip: Egg – quả trứng.

words.ex: We eat rice with almost every meal.
words.tip: Rice – cơm/gạo, thức ăn quen của người Việt.

words.ex: He doesn't eat much red meat.
words.tip: Meat – thịt nói chung.

words.ex: Fresh fish is cheaper at the morning market.
words.tip: Fish – cá, vừa là con cá vừa là món cá.

words.ex: I bought a whole chicken for the soup.
words.tip: Chicken – thịt gà hoặc con gà.

words.ex: An apple a day is a good habit.
words.tip: Apple – quả táo.

words.ex: Eat more vegetables with your lunch.
words.tip: Vegetable – rau củ, nhớ đuôi -table.

words.ex: There is a bowl of fruit on the table.
words.tip: Fruit – trái cây, không thêm s khi nói chung.

words.ex: She sprinkled cheese on top of the pasta.
words.tip: Cheese – phô mai, nghe như "chiz".

words.ex: Spread some butter on your toast.
words.tip: Butter – bơ động vật, khác avocado.

words.ex: Check the shopping list before we leave.
words.tip: Shopping list – danh sách đi chợ, tránh mua thừa.
words.def: a list of things you plan to buy

words.ex: Take a basket if you only need a few things.
words.tip: Basket – cái giỏ xách khi đi siêu thị.

words.ex: He pushed the trolley down the cereal aisle.
words.tip: Trolley – xe đẩy siêu thị (Anh); Mỹ gọi là cart.
words.def: a small cart with wheels used in shops

words.ex: Pasta is in aisle five, next to the rice.
words.tip: Aisle đọc "ai-l", chữ s câm.

words.ex: Keep the receipt in case you want to return it.
words.tip: Receipt – hóa đơn, chữ p câm.

words.ex: There is a ten percent discount on fruit today.
words.tip: Discount – giảm giá, dis- = bớt đi.

words.ex: Check each ingredient before you start cooking.
words.tip: Ingredient – nguyên liệu, nhóm với recipe.

words.ex: She only buys organic vegetables from the farm.
words.tip: Organic – hữu cơ, trồng không hóa chất.

words.ex: We ate the leftovers for lunch the next day.
words.tip: Left + overs = phần còn dư của bữa trước.
words.def: food that remains after a meal

words.ex: Perishable goods must go in the fridge quickly.
words.tip: Perish = hỏng; perishable = dễ hỏng, mau thối.

words.ex: Can I see the menu, please?
words.tip: Menu – thực đơn, y như tiếng Việt.

words.ex: Are you ready to order now?
words.tip: Order – gọi món, cũng là thứ tự.

words.ex: The waiter brought us some water first.
words.tip: Wait + er = người phục vụ chờ khách.

words.ex: Could we have the bill, please?
words.tip: Bill – hóa đơn nhà hàng (Anh); Mỹ dùng check.

words.ex: We left a ten percent tip for the waiter.
words.tip: Tip – tiền boa cho người phục vụ.

words.ex: I booked a table for four at seven.
words.tip: Table – bàn, "book a table" = đặt bàn.

words.ex: We have a reservation under the name Nguyen.
words.tip: Reservation – đặt chỗ trước, từ reserve = giữ chỗ.

words.ex: I'll have soup as a starter.
words.tip: Start + er = món khai vị.
words.def: a small dish served before the main course

words.ex: The main course was grilled salmon with rice.
words.tip: Main course – món chính giữa bữa.
words.def: the biggest dish of a meal

words.ex: Do you have room for dessert?
words.tip: Dessert hai chữ s (ngọt hơn desert sa mạc).

words.ex: Fries come as a side dish with the burger.
words.tip: Side dish – món ăn kèm bên cạnh món chính.
words.def: a smaller dish served with the main dish

words.ex: Let's get a takeaway and watch a film.
words.tip: Take + away = mang đi (Mỹ: takeout).

words.ex: The set menu is cheaper than ordering separately.
words.tip: Set menu – thực đơn trọn gói, giá cố định.

words.ex: The portions here are huge, so share one.
words.tip: Portion – suất ăn, gần với "phần".

words.ex: Bread is complimentary while you wait for your meal.
words.tip: Complimentary – miễn phí do quán tặng.

words.ex: What do you recommend for a first-time visitor?
words.tip: Recommend – giới thiệu món ngon.

words.ex: The restaurant is booked up for this Saturday.
words.tip: Booked up – kín chỗ, hết bàn.
words.def: with no free tables or places left

words.ex: Could we get some extra cutlery, please?
words.tip: Cutlery – dao muỗng nĩa gọi chung, không có s.
words.def: knives, forks and spoons for eating

words.ex: Can you eat noodles with chopsticks?
words.tip: Chopsticks – đũa, luôn có s.
words.def: two thin sticks used to eat food

words.ex: Put the napkin on your lap.
words.tip: Napkin – khăn ăn, đặt trên đùi khi dùng bữa.
words.def: a piece of cloth or paper for wiping your mouth

words.ex: My father cooks dinner on Sundays.
words.tip: Cook – nấu ăn, người nấu cũng là cook.

words.ex: Boil the water before you add the noodles.
words.tip: Boil – luộc/đun sôi, nghe như "boi".
words.def: to cook in water that is bubbling hot

words.ex: Fry the onions until they turn golden.
words.tip: Fry – chiên, áp chảo trong dầu.

words.ex: She bakes bread every weekend.
words.tip: Bake – nướng bằng lò, ra bánh.

words.ex: Chop the garlic into very small pieces.
words.tip: Chop – băm, cắt nhỏ bằng dao.
words.def: to cut food into small pieces with a knife

words.ex: Stir the soup so it does not stick to the pot.
words.tip: Stir – khuấy đều, hay đi với soup.

words.ex: Slice the tomatoes thinly for the salad.
words.tip: Slice – cắt lát mỏng.

words.ex: Peel the potatoes and cut them into cubes.
words.tip: Peel – gọt vỏ trái cây, củ.

words.ex: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
words.tip: Mix – trộn đều các thứ vào nhau.

words.ex: Pour the sauce over the noodles.
words.tip: Pour – rót, đổ chất lỏng.

words.ex: We grilled corn and fish in the garden.
words.tip: Grill – nướng vỉ trên than hoặc lửa.

words.ex: Steam the vegetables for five minutes only.
words.tip: Steam – hấp, hơi nước.

words.ex: She roasted a chicken with potatoes and herbs.
words.tip: Roast – quay trong lò, thường là thịt, khoai.

words.ex: Let the soup simmer for twenty minutes on low heat.
words.tip: Simmer – ninh lửa liu riu, sôi lăn tăn.
words.def: to cook gently just below boiling point

words.ex: This recipe takes only twenty minutes.
words.tip: Recipe – công thức nấu ăn, đọc "re-xi-pi".

words.ex: Heat some oil in a large pan.
words.tip: Pan – chảo, nhớ frying pan.

words.ex: There is a pot of soup on the stove.
words.tip: Pot – nồi, cái nồi nấu canh.

words.ex: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
words.tip: Oven – lò nướng, đọc "ơ-vờn".

words.ex: Use a sharp knife to cut the meat.
words.tip: Knife – con dao, chữ k câm.

words.ex: Add one spoon of sugar to the cup.
words.tip: Spoon – cái muỗng, hai chữ o.

words.ex: She put the noodles in a big bowl.
words.tip: Bowl – cái tô, cái bát.

words.ex: Add a little salt to the soup.
words.tip: Salt – muối.

words.ex: Do you want some pepper on your eggs?
words.tip: Pepper – tiêu; cũng là ớt chuông (bell pepper).

words.ex: I don't take sugar in my coffee.
words.tip: Sugar – đường.

words.ex: Fry the garlic first, then add the meat.
words.tip: Garlic – tỏi, nhấn âm đầu "GAR-lic".
words.def: a strong-smelling white bulb used in cooking

words.ex: The noodles come with a spicy sauce.
words.tip: Sauce – nước sốt, nước chấm.
words.def: a thick liquid served with food

words.ex: Knead the dough until it is smooth.
words.tip: Dough đọc "đô", bột nhào làm bánh mì.
words.def: a soft mix of flour and water for bread

words.ex: Marinate the chicken overnight for a stronger flavour.
words.tip: Marinate – ướp thịt cho ngấm gia vị.
words.def: to soak food in a sauce before cooking

words.ex: Season the meat with salt and pepper before cooking.
words.tip: Season – nêm nếm; cũng là mùa trong năm.

words.ex: Can I have a glass of water, please?
words.tip: Water – nước, thứ quen nhất.

words.ex: I usually drink coffee before work.
words.tip: Coffee – cà phê, hai chữ f và hai chữ e.

words.ex: Would you like some tea or coffee?
words.tip: Tea – trà, đọc "ti".

words.ex: She drinks orange juice every morning.
words.tip: Juice – nước ép, nhớ cặp orange juice.

words.ex: Kids usually prefer a soft drink at parties.
words.tip: Soft drink – nước ngọt không cồn, như cola.
words.def: a cold sweet drink without alcohol

words.ex: He ordered a cold beer after the match.
words.tip: Beer – bia, hai chữ e.

words.ex: They had a glass of red wine with dinner.
words.tip: Wine – rượu vang.

words.ex: He poured water into a clean glass.
words.tip: Glass – cái ly, cũng là kính.

words.ex: I'd like a cup of tea, please.
words.tip: Cup – cái tách.

words.ex: She carries a bottle of water in her bag.
words.tip: Bottle – chai, quen thuộc.

words.ex: I'll have sparkling water with ice and lemon.
words.tip: Sparkling – lấp lánh; nước có ga.
words.def: water with bubbles of gas in it

words.ex: A medium latte with oat milk, please.
words.tip: Latte – cà phê sữa kiểu Ý.
words.def: coffee with a lot of hot milk

words.ex: He had a double espresso to wake up.
words.tip: Espresso – cà phê đậm trong ly nhỏ, không phải "ex-".
words.def: a small, strong black coffee

words.ex: She ordered a banana and mango smoothie.
words.tip: Smoothie – sinh tố trái cây xay.
words.def: a thick drink of blended fruit

words.ex: Can I get a refill of my coffee, please?
words.tip: Re + fill = rót đầy lại lần nữa.

words.ex: I'll have a decaf; caffeine keeps me awake.
words.tip: Decaf – cà phê khử caffeine, viết tắt decaffeinated.
words.def: coffee with the caffeine removed

words.ex: The barista drew a heart on my latte.
words.tip: Barista – người pha cà phê chuyên nghiệp.
words.def: a person who makes coffee in a café

words.ex: Too much caffeine makes me nervous at night.
words.tip: Caffeine – chất caffein trong cà phê, trà.
words.def: a substance in coffee and tea that keeps you awake

words.ex: He brews fresh coffee every morning before work.
words.tip: Brew – pha, ủ trà hoặc nấu bia.
words.def: to make tea, coffee or beer

words.ex: No ice in my drink, please.
words.tip: Ice – đá lạnh, ice cream = kem.

words.ex: Do you have paper straws instead of plastic ones?
words.tip: Straw – ống hút, cũng là rơm.

words.ex: I'll take it in a takeout cup, please.
words.tip: Takeout cup – ly mang đi.
words.def: a cup with a lid for taking drinks away

words.ex: I have breakfast at seven every day.
words.tip: Break + fast = phá cơn đói sau đêm.

words.ex: Let's have lunch at noon.
words.tip: Lunch – bữa trưa.

words.ex: We eat dinner together at six.
words.tip: Dinner – bữa tối chính trong ngày.

words.ex: I eat a small snack at four o'clock.
words.tip: Snack – bữa ăn vặt nhẹ giữa các bữa.

words.ex: I'm so hungry; let's eat now.
words.tip: Hungry – đói, hunger = cơn đói.

words.ex: After the run I was very thirsty.
words.tip: Thirsty – khát, thirst = cơn khát.

words.ex: This soup is absolutely delicious.
words.tip: Delicious – ngon, mạnh hơn "good".

words.ex: The noodles were cheap but very tasty.
words.tip: Tasty – ngon miệng, taste + y.

words.ex: This mango is really sweet.
words.tip: Sweet – ngọt, cũng là đáng yêu.

words.ex: The lemon was too sour to eat.
words.tip: Sour – chua, như chanh.
words.def: having a sharp taste like a lemon

words.ex: Black coffee without sugar tastes bitter to me.
words.tip: Bitter – đắng, như cà phê đen.

words.ex: The soup is a bit too salty.
words.tip: Salty – mặn, salt + y.
words.def: containing a lot of salt

words.ex: I can't eat very spicy food.
words.tip: Spicy – cay, như ớt.
words.def: having a hot taste from spices

words.ex: The vegetables are fresh from the farm.
words.tip: Fresh – tươi, mới.

words.ex: The fried chicken was golden and crispy.
words.tip: Crispy – giòn, nghe "crisp" như tiếng rắc.
words.def: hard and dry in a pleasant way

words.ex: The burger was too greasy for me.
words.tip: Greasy – nhiều dầu mỡ, ngấy.
words.def: containing or covered with too much oil

words.ex: The soup was healthy but a bit bland.
words.tip: Bland – nhạt nhẽo, thiếu vị.
words.def: having little taste

words.ex: The soup is cheap but really filling.
words.tip: Fill → filling: ăn no lâu, chắc bụng.
words.def: making you feel full after eating

words.ex: I lost my appetite when I felt ill.
words.tip: Appetite – cảm giác thèm ăn, ngon miệng.

words.ex: This ice cream has a rich chocolate flavour.
words.tip: Flavour (Mỹ: flavor) – hương vị.
words.def: the taste of food or drink

words.ex: The smell of fresh bread was mouth-watering.
words.tip: Mouth + water = nhỏ dãi, thèm chảy nước miếng.

words.ex: My sister is vegetarian, so we skip meat.
words.tip: Vegetarian – ăn chay (vẫn dùng trứng sữa).

words.ex: Is there a vegan option on the menu?
words.tip: Vegan – thuần chay, không trứng, sữa.
words.def: eating no animal products at all

words.ex: He is on a diet to lose some weight.
words.tip: Diet – chế độ ăn, cả kiêng và ăn uống nói chung.

words.ex: Fruit and vegetables are very healthy.
words.tip: Health + y = tốt cho sức khỏe.

words.ex: I'm allergic to peanuts, so please avoid them.
words.tip: Allergic – bị dị ứng, luôn đi với "to".
words.def: having a bad reaction to a substance

words.ex: She has a serious shellfish allergy.
words.tip: Allergy – chứng dị ứng, đọc "a-lơ-gi".

words.ex: Do you have any gluten-free bread?
words.tip: Gluten-free – không có gluten, hợp người dị ứng bột mì.

words.ex: He avoids lactose, so he drinks oat milk.
words.tip: Lactose – đường sữa; lactose-free = không đường sữa.
words.def: a natural sugar found in milk

words.ex: Do these cookies contain nuts?
words.tip: Nut – hạt, kể cả đậu phộng.
words.def: a hard-shelled seed that you can eat

words.ex: Peanut butter is not safe for him.
words.tip: Peanut – đậu phộng, thường gây dị ứng.
words.def: a small oval nut that grows underground

words.ex: Shellfish like shrimp can cause allergies.
words.tip: Shell + fish = hải sản có vỏ như tôm, cua.
words.def: sea animals with shells, such as shrimp

words.ex: Always read the ingredients list on the packet.
words.tip: Ingredients list – bảng thành phần trên bao bì.
words.def: a list of what is in a food product

words.ex: A burger has many more calories than a salad.
words.tip: Calorie – calo, quen từ dinh dưỡng.
words.def: a unit for measuring the energy in food

words.ex: Eggs and beans are a good source of protein.
words.tip: Protein – chất đạm, có trong thịt, trứng, đậu.

words.ex: Do you have a sugar-free soft drink?
words.tip: Sugar-free – không đường.
words.def: containing no sugar

words.ex: Fasting during the day is part of Ramadan.
words.tip: Fast – nhịn ăn, fasting là hành động nhịn.
words.def: going without food for a period of time

words.ex: Is the chicken here halal?
words.tip: Halal – món hợp đạo Hồi theo quy định.
words.def: food allowed under Islamic rules

words.ex: She has a lactose intolerance, so she avoids milk.
words.tip: Intolerance – không dung nạp, khác dị ứng nặng.
words.def: inability to digest a food without problems

words.ex: Good nutrition helps children grow strong.
words.tip: Nutrition – dinh dưỡng, từ nutrient = chất dinh dưỡng.

words.ex: A balanced diet includes fruit, grains and protein.
words.tip: Balanced – cân bằng, đủ các nhóm thực phẩm.
words.def: containing the right mix of different things

words.ex: I'm trying to cut down on sugar this month.
words.tip: Cut down on – giảm bớt, không bỏ hẳn.

words.ex: I always overeat when there is free food.
words.tip: Over + eat = ăn quá nhiều, ăn quá độ.
words.def: to eat more than you need

phrases.en: Could we see the menu, please?
phrases.vi: Cho chúng tôi xem thực đơn nhé?

phrases.en: I'd like the chicken soup, please.
phrases.vi: Tôi muốn món súp gà, làm ơn.

phrases.en: Could we have the bill, please?
phrases.vi: Cho chúng tôi xin hóa đơn nhé?

phrases.en: Is service included in the bill?
phrases.vi: Hóa đơn đã gồm phí phục vụ chưa?

phrases.en: Can we split the bill?
phrases.vi: Chúng tôi chia hóa đơn được không?

phrases.en: I booked a table for four at seven.
phrases.vi: Tôi đã đặt bàn cho bốn người lúc bảy giờ.

phrases.en: What do you recommend?
phrases.vi: Bạn gợi ý món nào?

phrases.en: Could I have this to take away?
phrases.vi: Cho tôi mang món này đi được không?

phrases.en: Where can I find rice?
phrases.vi: Tôi tìm gạo ở đâu vậy?

phrases.en: How much is a kilo of apples?
phrases.vi: Một ký táo giá bao nhiêu?

phrases.en: Do you have a bag, please?
phrases.vi: Bạn có túi cho tôi không?

phrases.en: Is this on sale today?
phrases.vi: Món này hôm nay có giảm giá không?

phrases.en: Could I get a refund on this?
phrases.vi: Tôi trả lại món này lấy tiền lại được không?

phrases.en: Cook it on low heat for ten minutes.
phrases.vi: Nấu lửa nhỏ trong mười phút.

phrases.en: Add salt and pepper to taste.
phrases.vi: Nêm muối và tiêu vừa ăn.

phrases.en: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees.
phrases.vi: Làm nóng lò trước ở 180 độ.

phrases.en: Could you pass me the salt?
phrases.vi: Đưa giúp tôi lọ muối nhé?

phrases.en: A coffee with milk, please.
phrases.vi: Cho tôi một cà phê sữa.

phrases.en: Can I get a refill?
phrases.vi: Tôi xin rót thêm được không?

phrases.en: No sugar and no ice, please.
phrases.vi: Không đường, không đá nhé.

phrases.en: I'll have it to go, please.
phrases.vi: Tôi lấy mang đi nhé.

phrases.en: This is delicious!
phrases.vi: Món này ngon quá!

phrases.en: It's a bit too spicy for me.
phrases.vi: Món này cay quá với tôi.

phrases.en: I'm starving. Let's eat now.
phrases.vi: Tôi đói meo rồi. Ăn thôi.

phrases.en: I'm full, thank you.
phrases.vi: Tôi no rồi, cảm ơn.

phrases.en: I'm allergic to peanuts.
phrases.vi: Tôi bị dị ứng đậu phộng.

phrases.en: Does this dish contain nuts?
phrases.vi: Món này có hạt không?

phrases.en: Do you have vegetarian options?
phrases.vi: Bên bạn có món chay không?

phrases.en: I can't eat gluten.
phrases.vi: Tôi không ăn được gluten.

phrases.en: Could you leave out the onions?
phrases.vi: Bạn bỏ hành giúp tôi được không?

lines: A
Do we have enough rice for the week?
Nhà mình còn đủ gạo cho cả tuần không?
B
No, add it to the shopping list.
Không, thêm vào danh sách đi chợ đi.
A
OK. I'll grab a trolley at the door.
Được. Anh lấy xe đẩy ở cửa nhé.
A

Xin lỗi, quầy phô mai ở dãy nào vậy?
B
Aisle four, next to the butter.
Dãy bốn, cạnh chỗ bơ.
A
Thanks. Is there a discount on organic milk?
Cảm ơn. Sữa hữu cơ có giảm giá không?
B
Yes, ten percent off today.
Có, hôm nay giảm mười phần trăm.
A
Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
Chào buổi tối. Quý khách đặt bàn chưa?
B
Yes, a table for four under Linh.
Rồi, bàn bốn người, tên Linh.
A
Right this way. Here is the menu.
Mời đi lối này. Đây là thực đơn.
A
Are you ready to order?
Quý khách đã gọi món chưa?
B
Yes, soup as a starter, then the grilled fish.
Rồi, súp khai vị, sau đó cá nướng.
A
And would you like anything to drink?
Quý khách dùng đồ uống gì không?
B
Sparkling water, please.
Cho tôi nước có ga.
A
How long should I boil the eggs?
Luộc trứng bao lâu vậy?
B
About ten minutes. Then peel them.
Khoảng mười phút. Rồi bóc vỏ.
